_comment: Splatoon Raiders ExeFS of update title version 65536 (the first update), the version generated/raiders is lifted from and the only one SPR Recomp is tested on. Hashes only; no game data. The installer (installer/raiders.py) also accepts the other versions of expected-raiders-*.json and unknown versions of the game, with a warning that they are experimental. tools/build_game.py --version raiders links an executable that refuses any ExeFS but the one it was built for.
